name: Merch Marketplace Counts
title: Merch Marketplace Counts: Redbubble, TeePublic, Etsy, Amazon
uses: Print on demand sellers checking how crowded a shirt or sticker niche is before they design
Merch researchers comparing Redbubble, TeePublic, Etsy and Merch by Amazon counts for a keyword list
Pairing with a trademark screen to shortlist phrases that are both safe and under-served
AI agents that score merch ideas by competition with real marketplace counts

inputs.name: keywords
inputs.title: Keywords
inputs.description: Phrases or merch keywords, one per line, e.g. christmas cat shirt.

inputs.name: maxListings
inputs.title: Max listings per marketplace
inputs.description: How many top listing titles and URLs to return for each marketplace that is reachable.

inputs.name: marketplaces
inputs.title: Marketplaces
inputs.description: Which stores to query. Amazon is a Merch-by-Amazon shirt count when the filter is accepted; otherwise the general search count is returned and flagged.

description: For each merch keyword, return result counts and the top 20 listing titles and URLs from Redbubble, plus TeePublic, Etsy and Amazon Merch shirt counts when those sites allow datacenter access. Blocked marketplaces are flagged, never guessed. $0.002 per keyword.
